comments.text:
johnny was a good lad, its unfortunate on one windy night he had gone out to buy some smokes from the local liquor store on his way back he stopped to sign autograghs.
A large gruffy mark chapman shoved a saturday night special onto johnnys gut like jack ruby did to oswald. He started plugging johnny , johnny helpless body was dancing, arms flailing as the rounds found there mark. Eventually johnnys body toppled over, breaking wind as he collapsed on the sidewalk.
As he was on the ground he tried to say something, a curious onlooker bent down to see what he was saying, johnny spoke his final words "I been shot" and let one rip as the holy ghost left his lifeless corpse. The poet sang no more.
Howard cosell interrupted monday night football to announce to the world johnnys untimely demise. He was just a simple thug from the mean streets of liverpool, and he died like his idol John dillenger, gun down in the street.
comments.author: @jonyjoe8464
